newsitem.title: UK: Sole Brent cargo kept from chains - trade.
newsitem.headline: Sole Brent cargo kept from chains - trade.

text.p: The only Brent crude cargo nominated from the paper chains on Thursday was kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The March 28-30 loader was kept by Stasco, they said.
The final three March Brents will turn wet on Friday.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
